name: "Physical Culture" by Augustas Serapinas
description: Explore this intriguing contemporary art show at the Porto Municipal Gallery, located in the gardens of the Palácio de Cristal.
longDescription:
"Physical Culture" is a contemporary art exhibition by Lithuanian artist Augustas Serapinas, presented at the Galeria Municipal do Porto. The exhibition explores themes related to the human body, its interaction with space, and the cultural constructs surrounding physical activity and wellness. Serapinas's work often involves site-specific interventions and a playful engagement with architectural and social environments, inviting viewers to reconsider everyday phenomena.

Visitors to "Physical Culture" can expect to encounter a series of installations and artworks that challenge perceptions of physical exertion and the spaces designed for it. The exhibition is housed within the Galeria Municipal do Porto, a modern exhibition space situated within the scenic gardens of the Palácio de Cristal, offering a contemplative setting for viewing contemporary art. The duration of a visit will vary depending on individual engagement with the pieces.

Admission to "Physical Culture" is free. The exhibition runs from October 1st to October 18th, 2026. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is accessible via public transport; it is a short walk from several bus stops serving the Palácio de Cristal area.
